crossRefs.note: He joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish. They made the ships in Ezion Geber.
They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of…
Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go; for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.
So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and…

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Elath
people.line: Edomite port on the Red Sea; fortified by Judah

people.name: Ezion-geber
people.line: Israelite encampment; port city on Red Sea

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.
translations.bsb: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and to Eloth on the coast of Edom.
translations.kjv: Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
